text:
Vote SB19, A’TIN voting campaign, support Filipino artists
A’TIN, need everyone to focus on voting. This is only until August 16, 12AM PHT.
As of this writing, we’re down by almost 400K votes. Let this be our motivation to unite & win this round for our boys & country.
- YOU MAY ALSO LIKE TO WATCH THIS TRENDING STORY ON YOUTUBE. Waverly Hills Hospital's Horror Story: The Most Haunted Room 502
— SB19 VOTING TEAM (@SB19_VotingTeam)
[August 14, 2025]
A’TIN, Need Everyone to Focus on Voting
Hey A’TIN! It’s time to rally together and focus on voting for our beloved group, SB19. The voting period is crucial and runs until August 16, 12 AM PHT. Every vote counts, and right now, we’re trailing by almost 400K votes. But don’t worry; this is our chance to unite and show our support for the boys who have given us so much joy and inspiration.
As passionate fans, it’s important that we come together and make our voices heard. Every single vote can make a difference in this competition. If you haven’t voted yet, now is the perfect time to jump in and help our boys secure a win. Let’s use this as motivation to push harder and show that A’TIN can accomplish anything when we work together.
You can cast your votes at the link provided by the SB19 Voting Team. Click here to vote. Let’s not just aim for the win; let’s aim to set a record for participation!
Unite for Our Boys and Country
This isn’t just about winning; it’s about representing our love for SB19 and our pride in our country. Every vote symbolizes our collective effort and belief in their talent. The boys have worked incredibly hard, and now it’s our turn to step up for them.
So, gear up, A’TIN! Share this message with friends, family, and fellow fans. Encourage them to vote and join in the excitement. Don’t forget to use the hashtags to spread awareness: #SB19 and #VoteSB19onBBFA2025 on social media platforms. Together, we can bridge the gap and secure a victory for SB19!
